_comment: Expected status of every check, compared by `conformance --expect`. Any difference in either direction is an error: a check that silently degrades to "skip" leaves the score at 100% because skips are excluded from the denominator, which is this suite's dominant failure mode. Regenerate deliberately with `--write-expect`, and read the diff. NOTE: "offline" means no lab infrastructure of any kind — no control server and no TLS front (tests/lab/tls.sh). This file was first generated on a machine that happened to have the TLS front running, which made transport.tls read "pass"; CI caught it on the first run, which is the whole point of comparing rather than trusting the score.
